requests.tool_or_program_name: TOOL016 retrospective WIC error and feedback sweep
requests.purpose: Collect all currently accessible WIC tool/chat development and real-use error, failure, repeated-error, inconvenience, modification-request and feedback evidence from existing TOOL016 ledger, function state, failure evidence, error records, queues, checkpoints and other accessible repository evidence; deduplicate by ROOT and MISSING_CAPABILITY; skip already VERIFIED items; hand unresolved capability gaps to TOOL044 without requiring the user to re-enter historical errors.
requests.desired_result: TOOL016 accessible historical evidence -> deduplicated ROOT/MISSING_CAPABILITY set -> TOOL044 atomic demands -> verified component/framework discovery and composition pipeline. Records not actually accessible must be marked ACCESS_NOT_AVAILABLE rather than claimed collected.
